name: gore
description: Author Gothic 1 Remake mods or safely import, enable, order, analyze, preflight, apply, check status, recover, remove, and reset GORE or external mods.

allow_write.title: Change the install or protected Manager content without confirming
allow_write.description: Off by default: installation changes and protected Manager import, replacement, removal, recovery, and Reset calls are confirmed first. Reversible enable, disable, and order edits update the target loadout immediately without this setting.

allow_game_launch.title: Start the game to compile AngelScript without confirming
allow_game_launch.description: Compiling opens a real game window and takes minutes. It also writes to the installation, so it needs the setting above as well.
